description: This file contains power management functions for deep sleep and light sleep modes on a Microchip MEC1501 platform within the Zephyr RTOS, including sleep state transitions and register manipulations.

methods.name: z_power_soc_deep_sleep
methods.description: Handles entering deep sleep mode, including masking interrupts, saving peripheral state, enabling deep sleep, waiting for PLL lock, and restoring peripheral state.

methods.name: z_power_soc_sleep
methods.description: Handles entering light sleep mode with minimal power savings but fast wake response.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Sets the power management state, invoking deep or light sleep functions based on the requested state.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Re-enables interrupts and performs necessary fence operations after waking from suspend states.
